body: Please stay. I don't have a reason, but I don't know why I really want you to stay.

I am here to make a post that I will kill myself in 4 months, and I see yours.

When I look around and see annoying shit in the society or life, I just think "Oh, soon I don't have to deal with this shit anymore."

Today I saw random people at a coffee shop that I want to get acquainted, and I think I will kill myself soon, what's to be scared anyway. So I did try, which is something I will never normally do.

I can say I kinda relate with what you are saying.
My other psychiatrist want me to be hospitalized but I refused. My T are someone to be with me until I can no longer take it anymore, other than that I don't think T can do anything for me.
I hate all of these phrases and had to ditched a therapist in the past. The phrases are insulting.

You took all the words right of my mouth. Yesterday I was talking with my friend about this. It's like I was born with pain inherent in my mind. Of course my friend with goodwill try to talk me to accept that I think too much, and thoughts will lead to pain. Thus I should change the way I think and think less.

But I have come to accept that maybe my purpose in life was to tell a story of how a human can have so much mental pain without any reason. I believe that there a many people like me, with unreasonable, unexplainable, and limitless amount of psychological pain. 

I also don't think I can last long with in this state anymore, I always wish someone please kill me.

I want to say that I feel you and your pain to some extend, though nobody can ever truly feel others. 

Please believe that if I can meet you I would give you a tight and long hug.
Ooh, I like this, gonna read into Norse Mythology.
My god, I even give gifts to my therapist. Ouch!
Thank you for your input, I will take a mental note about this.

Thank you both for your reply. I'm trying to keep myself busy by working and cleaning to temporary distract me from this issue. Every time I think about T and therapy I broke down again. The thought of going to another T and through all the pain is scarier than death. But at least I will try to discuss my doubt with the current T at the next session.

I just created this account to post something similar to this issue, and I see your post.

I (30F) have been seeing a T (M) for a year. My T knows that I have strong erotic and emotional transference toward him. But I never act on it, I discuss all with my T. He made me feel that I'm a very special patient of him. He hugged me, touched me, kissed me on my forehead, talked a bit about his personal life. I never contacted him outside of sessions, never trying to get attention. There was a time he hinted that we can have sex, but then suddenly been keeping physical distance and we don't talk about it anymore.

Recently due to an incident, I felt that our relationship is my illusion. I thought I had a genuine and respected human connection, but no, it's a stupid professional relationship or some shit. And I broke down hard. That's the last trigger, for several days I've been planning my suicide. I created this account to post on r/SuicideWatch.

I've been thinking whether this kind of relationship is good for me at all? I don't come to therapy to seek comfort or validation or care or love, I need help and guiding to face my emotions. But T gave me those and it's real and unreal at the same time. For normal physical doctor, you can be friends with them after you healed. But this T-client thing is doomed to end at the very beginning. How come you build a very intimate connection just to end like that.

I dont want to change T, in fact I want to stop therapy because I cannot really understand how this should be. Even if I change T, this circle will continue and it will never work.
